phase3-b0-s42-8825ad18a7c7fe17.config/phase1_effective.yaml:
project:
  name: consendxformer
  display_name: ConsenDxFormer
  title: 'ConsenDxFormer: A Disagreement-Aware CNN–Transformer Model with Explainable
    Attention for Pulmonary Nodule Malignancy Stratification'
  phase: 1
reproducibility:
  seed: 2026
  deterministic_algorithms: true
  cudnn_benchmark: false
  split_algorithm: sha256_rank_v1
paths:
  phase0_dir: artifacts/phase0
  manifest_dir: artifacts/phase0/manifests
  baseline_repo_dir: external/LungDxFormer
baseline:
  name: LungDxFormer
  source_lock_file: locks/baseline_sources.yaml
  repository_dir: external/LungDxFormer
  project_subdir: LungDxFormer
  released_config: LungDxFormer/configs/config.yaml
  training_entrypoint: LungDxFormer/src/train.py
frozen_manifest:
  directory: artifacts/phase0/manifests
  bundle_sha256: 0c983f0ebbc6dd70623b570c8a657aa14ccc550ac590b577648b3163bc8a01e3
  unique_patients: 1010
  unique_ct_series: 1018
  split_counts:
    train: 707
    val: 152
    test: 151
metadata:
  columns:
    patient_id: patient_id
    image_path: image_path
    label: label
  unknown_patient_policy: error

  num_classes: 3
